confidence_notes: I used two web searches. One found the RBA rate. The other checked cost-of-living sites for Dresden, mainly Expatica's summary of Numbeo data as of June 2026 and MyLifeElsewhere. That search gave averages of about EUR 13.5 for an inexpensive meal, EUR 79 for a mid-range meal for two, EUR 5.2 for a 0.5 L draft beer and EUR 3.8-4.0 for a cappuccino. I converted these to USD at about 1.10 USD per EUR, which I worked out from the cross rates in the RBA search results. The sources differ slightly, so I rounded the food figures up a little for July 2026. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. Those two are estimates based on how they usually compare with beer prices in Germany: a cocktail at about EUR 9-11 and a glass of wine at about EUR 5.5-6.5. They are less certain than the food figures. All accommodation figures come from general knowledge only, adjusted for Dresden's summer tourist season. I did not check any booking sites or listings. For the exchange rate I used the 18 November 2026 RBA figure, which was confirmed on the RBA overview page. A 19 November figure appeared on the RBA statistics page, but it may still be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are similar to or slightly below Leipzig and Berlin. Dresden is a mid-sized eastern German city with strong cultural tourism, so its hotel prices are below Munich and Hamburg.
